overview.purpose_zh: 这张折线图用来看四个地区在八个季度里的销售走势：谁一直领先，谁增长最快，谁几乎没怎么动。
works_zh: 比较四个地区在同一季度的差距
看每个地区的方向和拐点
分清最高值和最快增长不是同一回事
uses_zh: 给管理层讲增长来自哪里

understanding.read_zh: 先看四条线的大方向，再找每条线的起点、终点和拐点，最后比较增幅。不要只盯最后一个点：最高值和最快增长往往不是同一条线。

elements.note_zh: 从 2024 年一季度到 2025 年四季度，共八个季度。
销售额，单位是千美元；刻度越高，卖得越多。
四种颜色对应 East、South、North、West 四个地区。
East 被高亮，其他三条线变淡，方便先讲主线。
每条线最右边的点就是 2025 年四季度的值。

look_for_zh: 四条线是不是都在向上
哪条线起点最低、后来追上了谁
最高值和最快增长是不是同一条线

observations.en: All four regions sold more in 2025-Q4 than in 2024-Q1.
observations.zh: 四个地区 2025 年四季度的销售额都高于 2024 年一季度。

observations.en: East stayed on top every quarter and ended at 690, up 270 from 420.
observations.zh: 东部每个季度都排第一，最后到 690，比 420 多了 270。

observations.en: East and South hold the top two places in every quarter, with West and North behind them.
observations.zh: 每个季度前两名都是东部和南部，西部和北部排在后面。

observations.en: West more than doubled, from 190 to 415, the fastest relative growth of the four.
observations.zh: 西部从 190 涨到 415，翻了一倍多，是四个地区里相对增长最快的。

observations.en: North grew slowest, from 260 to 334, a gain of 74.
observations.zh: 北部增长最慢，从 260 到 334，只增加了 74。

observations.en: West passed North in 2025-Q2, when it reached 326 against North's 305.
observations.zh: 西部在 2025 年二季度超过北部，达到 326，北部为 305。

observations.en: North slipped by 5 in 2024-Q2, the only quarter-on-quarter fall on the chart.
observations.zh: 北部在 2024 年二季度小幅回落 5，是整张图唯一一次环比下降。

describe.en: East increased from 420 in 2024-Q1 to 690 in 2025-Q4, a gain of 270.
describe.zh: 东部从 2024 年一季度的 420 增长到 2025 年四季度的 690，共增加 270。
alternatives: East rose from 420 to 690 across the eight quarters.
There was an increase of 270 in East sales between 2024-Q1 and 2025-Q4.
describe.note_zh: 起点和终点都给出来，听的人不用自己算。

describe.en: West grew by 225, from 190 to 415, more than doubling over the period.
describe.zh: 西部增长了 225，从 190 到 415，在这段时间里翻了一倍多。
describe.pattern: grow by + amount / grow from ... to ...
alternatives: West more than doubled, rising from 190 to 415.
describe.note_zh: by 后面是增量，from ... to ... 是起点和终点。

describe.en: East finished 238 higher than South in 2025-Q4, at 690 against 452.
describe.zh: 2025 年四季度，东部比南部高 238，为 690 对 452。
alternatives: East was 238 above South in the final quarter.
East's 690 was ahead of South's 452 by 238.
describe.note_zh: 比较两个具体数字时，把差值一起说出来更有信息量。

describe.en: North lagged behind the other three regions, ending at 334.
describe.zh: 北部落后于其他三个地区，最后停在 334。
alternatives: North trailed East, South and West with 334.
describe.note_zh: lag behind 只说明排在后面，不强调差多少，适合先给结论。

describe.en: East rose steadily across all eight quarters, with no down quarter.
describe.zh: 东部在八个季度里稳步上升，没有任何一个季度下降。
alternatives: There was a steady rise in East sales over the eight quarters.
describe.note_zh: steadily 表示每一段都在动、方向一致，不是一次跳上去。

describe.en: West increased from 190 to 415, a rise of 225.
describe.zh: 西部从 190 增长到 415，上升了 225。
describe.pattern: increase from + starting value + to + ending value
alternatives: The rise in West sales was 225.
describe.note_zh: 同一组数字可以拆成 from ... to ... 和 a rise of 两种说法。

describe.en: Overall, all four lines slope upward, but the gap between East and North widened from 160 to 356.
describe.zh: 总体来看，四条线都向上，但东部和北部之间的差距从 160 扩大到 356。
alternatives: Overall, every region grew, and East pulled further ahead of North.
The gap between East and North widened from 160 to 356.
describe.note_zh: Overall 放句首，先给大局，再补一个具体对比。

describe.zh: 东部在 2025 年四季度达到峰值 690。
describe.pattern: peak at + value / peak in + period
alternatives: East reached its highest point, 690, in the final quarter.
The highest value on the chart is East's 690.
describe.note_zh: peak at 接数值，peak in 接时间，两个介词别混。

academic.en: The line chart compares quarterly sales for four regions between 2024-Q1 and 2025-Q4. All four series trend upward. East remains the highest throughout and rises from 420 to 690, a gain of 270. South follows the same pattern at a lower level, finishing at 452. West is the fastest-growing series by percentage: it more than doubles, from 190 to 415, and moves above North in 2025-Q2. North records the smallest gain, 74, and the only decline, a fall of 5 in 2024-Q2. The gap between East and South widens from 110 to 238.
academic.zh: 这张折线图比较了 2024 年一季度到 2025 年四季度四个地区的季度销售额。四条线都向上。东部始终最高，从 420 升到 690，增加 270。南部走势相同但水平较低，最后为 452。西部按百分比是增长最快的：从 190 涨到 415，翻了一倍多，并在 2025 年二季度超过北部。北部增幅最小，为 74，也是唯一一次下降，2024 年二季度回落 5。东部与南部之间的差距从 110 扩大到 238。

business.en: East is still our biggest region at 690, but West is the story: sales there more than doubled from 190 to 415 and passed North in 2025-Q2. Across the four regions, quarterly sales rose from 1,180 to 1,891, so growth is broad rather than concentrated in one market. East added the largest absolute amount, 270, while North added just 74 and slipped once. The plan for next year should protect East's base and keep funding West's momentum.
business.zh: 东部仍是我们最大的区域，达到 690，但真正值得讲的是西部：销售额从 190 涨到 415，翻了一倍多，并在 2025 年二季度超过北部。四个地区合计，季度销售额从 1,180 升到 1,891，说明增长面很广，不是只靠一个市场。东部贡献了最大的绝对增量 270，北部只增加了 74，还出现过一次回落。明年的计划应该守住东部的基本盘，同时继续给西部投入。

simple.en: Sales went up in all four regions. East sold the most every quarter and ended at 690. West started at 190, the lowest, and finished at 415, more than double. North grew the least, from 260 to 334. In 2025-Q2, West passed North. Nothing fell for long: North had one small drop of 5 in 2024-Q2.
simple.zh: 四个地区的销售额都上涨了。东部每个季度都卖得最多，最后到 690。西部从最低的 190 起步，最后到 415，翻了一倍多。北部增长最少，从 260 到 334。2025 年二季度，西部超过了北部。整体没有持续下滑，只有北部在 2024 年二季度小幅下降了 5。

language_notes.body_zh: by 后面接增加的量，to 后面接最后的水平。说 East increased by 270, to 690，两个信息一次给全；只说 increased to 690，就没有说涨了多少。
examples: North increased to 334, a rise of 74.

language_notes.body_zh: highest 说的是数值最大，fastest 说的是变化速度最快。East 的 690 是最高值，但 West 从 190 到 415 的百分比增长最快。一句话里把这两个评价分开，听众就不会混。
examples: West has the fastest growth rate, more than doubling from 190 to 415.

language_notes.body_zh: double 是变成两倍，more than doubled 是超过两倍。West 从 190 到 415，超过了两倍，所以不能只说 doubled。
examples: West more than doubled, from 190 to 415.
Sales did not just double; they grew by 225.
